_about: Genetics layer rules. genotype_pattern finds the model term that holds the lines: a term whose analysis.terms meaning, spec factor name or layout column matches it. Systems decide whether lines are homozygous (inbred) when suite_genetics inbred = auto.
_note_systems: mouse and drosophila genotype levels are usually inbred strains (C57BL/6, DGRP lines); set suite_genetics inbred = FALSE for outbred stocks. A system in neither list is treated as inbred and listed as an assumption.
